purpose: Record newly discovered public research/data exhaust sources found after the Public Alpha Harvest mandate, rank incremental value, and prevent repeated discovery work.

sources.name: Chain of Title
incremental_value: Immutable first-block launch provenance that present-tense token scanners can no longer reconstruct cheaply after supply is redistributed.
Creator initial supply share, creator self-buy behavior, outside-buyer counts, curve fill speed, 40+ SOL buyout events, pool/vault reads and rebuild/late-discovery markers.
Operator/funder graph for wallets that take whole curves, while explicitly warning that common funder is a lead rather than identity/intent proof.
Whole archive is offered as a SQLite download and per-token/per-wallet JSON records are public, making it suitable as a bounded G1/G4 enrichment source.

Public negative result states that 19,412 simulated bonding-curve entries in a favorable organic subset during September 2026 produced zero 5x outcomes; useful as a regime/falsifier signal, not a universal theorem.
critical_boundaries: Coverage/rebuilt/late-discovery fields must be honored; absence outside observed coverage is not clean evidence.
Shared funder must not be equated with cabal/insider identity because terminals can fund users from common infrastructure.
Live pool balances are mutable snapshots with age, unlike immutable launch facts.
The 19,412-entry no-5x result applies to its dated selection and entry simulation; replicate before using as a tail prior.
Do not trigger historical rebuilds at scale through the public API; prefer the bulk archive for research and respect rebuild budgets.
sources.candidate_role: G1 launch-integrity and G4 creator/operator provenance; negative-regime benchmark; independent verifier for creator/self-buy/buyout/funding hypotheses.

sources.name: Trenches pump.fun Forward Capture 2026-08
sources.license: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 according to dataset card
incremental_value: Per-field derivability timestamps make point-in-time leakage directly measurable rather than assumed.
A forward-only time split with 10,800-second embargo is supplied; no shuffling.
Terminal chain account state supplies a checkable completion label.
The release documents a real timing leak: X reach data resolved a median 20.52 seconds after its recorded poll stamp, and reach_derivable_at_decision is false for all first-sighting mints.
Independent recent-August corpus is a strong replication bridge between June retrospective corpora and Alpha Lab's live September shadow.
critical_boundaries: Vendor feed is completion-enriched: path_completed is 1.135%, roughly five times the historical full-population rate quoted by the source, so do not use raw precision as market prevalence.
There is a documented 69.09-hour capture gap plus a second 2.09-hour gap; stratify pre/post gap.
858 non-pump.fun venues have no chain outcome and may not be pooled with pump.fun rates.
Use path_completed rather than the live graduated resolver because the latter has 80 known false negatives in this release.
Negative age at first sighting occurs for 1,225 mints; apply the documented derivability bound or exclude.
Curve-progress proxies are construction leakage and are explicitly banned from model features.
sources.candidate_role: Independent point-in-time feature replication, leakage canary calibration and forward-style G1/G2 validation.

sources.name: Zinteck/MELT
sources.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 according to dataset card
incremental_value: Large-scale pre/post migration, bundle and entity-resolution research corpus.
Dataset states features are computed strictly from pre-migration data to reduce label leakage.
Strong independent testbed for bundle/sniper/entity-adjusted concentration and manipulation controls.
critical_boundaries: Very large corpus, process selectively and preserve license restrictions.
External entity heuristics remain hypotheses until replicated against Alpha Lab's own event graph.
sources.candidate_role: G1 entity-adjusted concentration, bundle/manipulation and hidden-control research.

sources.name: Pump Studio sentiment/risk agent corpus
sources.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 according to dataset card
incremental_value: Validated live token snapshots paired with agent sentiment/risk submissions may support research into disagreement/consensus among external agents.
critical_boundaries: Sentiment and risk labels are agent-generated opinions, not forward market outcomes.
Multiple submissions per token/agent can create pseudo-replication.
Do not train Alpha Lab to imitate external agents without independent outcome linkage.
sources.candidate_role: Optional meta-research on agent disagreement after higher-value market/outcome corpora are exhausted.

sources.name: PumpSwap historical trades free sample
sources.license: Free sample for evaluation; full dataset commercial according to card
incremental_value: One-hour free ordered PumpSwap sample can validate parsers and execution-order semantics.
critical_boundaries: Full historical corpus is paid and is not authorized by this mandate.
One-hour sample is not a robust outcome dataset.
sources.candidate_role: Parser fixture only unless later value-of-information analysis justifies a paid purchase and user separately authorizes it.

sources.name: COPEAI lore corpus
sources.reason: Only 75 project-specific lore rows and no independent token outcome linkage; useful for provenance schema ideas but not empirical Moonshot alpha.

sources.name: Easfus crypto agent training corpus
sources.reason: Instruction/agent conversation training data rather than point-in-time market observations with independently resolved outcomes.

execution_change: Insert Chain of Title and the August Trenches forward capture into the active harvest before cross-dataset adjudication. Chain of Title supplies recent immutable launch/operator provenance; Trenches supplies a recent point-in-time leakage-auditable replication cohort.
